effectRules.persistentInScope: 遇德猶忌 inside one scope is exactly the 止忌 list; a 猶忌 from another subject (月破, 天賊, 四廢…) is a separate protected scope and is not merged here.

propagationInventory.note: Each line links two headings whose 忌 come from different scopes; applied only by a day-level composer.
